title: Unit Event — Kick It Up a Notch — Episode3 The Key Kohane Holds

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD is all set to perform at "Crawl Green" and are very excited about it. Kohane and the others are also looking forward to seeing Taiga there, but he happens to get a phone call which...

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(It's already time for practice...!
The others said that I didn't have to come if I became too pressed for time, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hmm... You produce such a clean sound, Toya. It's actually a bit of a shame that you're trying to keep everything short and sweet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Then, I'll try sounding a little rougher by using more power than usual.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Which means...
Sorry, Akito, but I'll need you to give me some extra time for that part.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, no problem.
We can find a balance as we go along.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're all sound so serious. Plus...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(The air feels so tense.
They're all really focused...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But... I guess that makes sense...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We get to perform where those three... Where RADder made their big debut.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(They were still in high school too...
Which means they were our age.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (In that sense, we're sort of alike...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(That means I need to do my best.
Also, what Taiga said earlier...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Kohane...!
Welcome back! You done practicing with Uncle Taiga?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hi, An, everyone.
Sorry for running late.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's okay.
We knew that there was a chance you wouldn't be able to make it today, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, what did you do with Taiga today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We went around taking photos of people in this city. But I didn't really understand what that had to do with singing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. His methods really do seem strange at times.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Hey, Azusawa, you made it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, now that we're all here, let's call practice here and start discussing our next event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it'll be better to have this discussion sooner rather than later since it's going to affect how we practice moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Right.
The people who go to the venue are a tough crowd, so I don't want to take any chances.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Plus, it's pretty rare of the owner to allow someone else to rent out the place and put on an event there. I have to think that expectations are going to be very high.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In other words, this is a huge chance for us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is really exciting.
So, what kind of event do you guys want this to be?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Well...
We chose a theme during our last discussion, so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
S-Sorry...!
There's something I need to ask you guys. Mind if I butt in...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, um...
A-About our next event...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd like to open for us. By myself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you mean? By yourself...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. So, Taiga told me just now that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Uncle Taiga put you up to this...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Makes sense...
Also, Azusawa, you already have some experience performing solo, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I do. Right after we formed our team, I performed a little here and there to gain more experience...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But the events you were in back then weren't all that big... This time, I mean... We're talking about Crawl Green here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah... I know that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Were we wrong about her this whole time...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is she better than we could've ever realized...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm for it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Based on where Kohane is right now, she should be able to handle flying solo. However, she's gonna need to practice for it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, I think it's worth a shot since you might strike it rich again like you did during STAY GOLDEN. After all, you getting better means we get better as a team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
At the very least...
I'm willing to bet on your performance.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
I'm on the fence.
In terms of going solo, I feel that I would be the better choice.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: If Kohane believes she has what it takes to reach even greater heights... Then, I'd like to give her a chance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Greater heights, huh...?
Yeah, I wanna give Kohane a chance too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, if it's okay with you guys, I'd like to let Kohane do this. I mean, we still have plenty of time before the event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. Let's move forward with that in mind. At minimum, Azusawa definitely has what it takes to succeed here.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I don't mind either and I agree with Shinonome. I have a feeling that Azusawa is going to transform again like she did during the last STAY GOLDEN.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
I promise to do my best! I won't let you down...!
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(My intonation's still off.
I need to sing more with more precision...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's going to be my job to get the crowd going from scratch. I need to really burst out of the gates sprinting...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And this may be Taiga's last chance to see me perform. At Crawl Green of all places too... I can't let this opportunity go to waste...!)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
She seems so focused.
You said she's been like this every day lately?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah... Outside of team practices, she's apparently been singing on Vivid Street, at Nonogi Park and other places.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just the day before, she lost track of time and stayed out super late, and her dad got really mad at her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The day before yesterday? So, after we practiced?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I didn't realize that had stayed back so late...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I've been practicing with you guys for a while now, but I still can't believe sometimes how much stamina you all have.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, the way she sang just now concerns me a little...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, Azusawa, do you have a minute...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, of course. How can I help?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The way you sang just now... I thought I should mention that I feel like you're straining to sing louder.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm... You guys thought so too?
I dunno how to describe it, but it's like you're having trouble finding your highest gear.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: You think so? I thought she was singing fine...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, this might be because we're so used to hearing her sing and know what she sounds like when she's at her best...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was doing my best to not let it affect my singing, but I guess I can't hide it anymore...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I'm starting to feel the pressure of having to set the pace for the entire event...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I mean, we don't blame you.
But it's not like you're singing bad or anything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True. You've accrued plenty of experience up to this point, Azusawa. I believe you'll do just fine if you practice like we normally do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay...
Thanks, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Tono, Mita!
Would you mind practicing with me for a little bit?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You've both been performing by yourselves for a long time, so I'd like it if you could tell me anything that bothers you!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Haha. As tireless as ever, I see.
Then, why don't we continue over there?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's starting to get dark. Let's call practice here for today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh no! Tono, Mita, I'm so sorry...!
I didn't mean to make you practice with me for so long...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Don't mind us. I'm happy to help whenever, so don't hesitate to ask!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: You still have a couple of rough patches to work through, but I think you'll be fine in time for our event as long as you keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Okay! Thank you very much.
I promise to be ready by then!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I really want to help Kohane somehow since she's been working her butt off every day...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, An, about our meeting tomorrow...
An emergency came up, so I won't be able to make it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
An emergency...?
Then, I guess I'll just have to go it alone...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I know!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane, are you free tomorrow?
You too, Akito, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't have any animal caretaker committee duties to do tomorrow, so I was planning on going home early to practice somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have library committee business to take care of tomorrow... But I may be able to leave early if I tell them what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm free too. I don't have work tomorrow, so my plan was to go train somewhere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, let's all go to Crawl Green!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What? To Crawl Green...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Kohane, Toya, neither of you have been there yet, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It'll be an opportunity to actually see what it's like, and it should be a nice breath of fresh air for Kohane. Two birds with one stone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I've been wanting to see what it's like. I can't wait to find out...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me too.
I've been curious as to what the place where Ken and his team debuted is like.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good. I also kinda want to go since that message has been bothering me.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No problem!
Then, we'll meet at my place after school and head over to Crawl Green together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
